token_enforcement: Stop on observed complete-turn usage reaching the limit; one in-flight request can overshoot. Missing usage stops collection as unmeasured, not zero. This is not a provider billing cap.
human_intervention: record and invalidate comparative pair; preserve all cost
order: baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline, alternating pair index
cache_policy: isolated per trial; paired_warm uses the exact same externally frozen seed inventory for both versions; never reuse a sibling trial's mutable cache
asset_access: same frozen URLs, source revisions, license constraints, metadata/model byte budgets and network policy for both versions
phase_measurement: host monotonic intervals only; overlapping intervals are unioned per phase, never subtracted from wall time to invent model waiting
strict_replay: separate no-model host phase using identical frozen input/run locks; never pooled with authoring
success: frozen host verifier validates provenance, physical predicates and video QA; agent prose is never a pass
report: success/quality first; all failure/timeout costs included; paired A-group pass/pass distributions separately; B unsupported capability gaps never token savings
unknown_policy: missing usage, billing, phase or byte evidence stays null
target: 30 percent comparable-token reduction is an unproven optimization target, never a result
pilot_gate: Two pilot pairs must validate usage, timeouts, host verification and provenance before any full schedule is authorized
wall_budget_scope: Codex process wall plus separately reported host verifier wall; file-copy/setup time recorded separately, not hidden. Stop after each explicit trial; no unattended schedule loop.

client_isolation.state: fresh per-trial CODEX_HOME; file-based login and model-capability metadata copied privately if available
client_isolation.excluded: global config, AGENTS instructions, plugin registrations, skills and conversation history
client_isolation.scope: client context plus trace audit; not an operating-system read jail

observation_collection: Worker records the full trajectory. Model inspects bounded representative observations and writes submission promptly; trusted host verifier reads the full unchanged trajectory. Applied identically to both packages.
cohort_changes: Changed evaluator/prompt/client-isolation inputs require a new frozen cohort. Keep earlier failures and unknown usage; never pool incompatible fingerprints.
